tagline: Manhattan Associates, Inc. is a global leader in providing cloud-based supply chain commerce solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Manhattan Associates integrates AI into its cloud solutions to optimize supply chains and commerce. The percentage of cloud contracts including AI capabilities is a key indicator of customer adoption of this technology.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.84 Bn € in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on cloud subscriptions
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on cloud subscription revenues, whose growth is essential to its performance.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned as crucial for growth. The language emphasizes dependence to generate revenue. Weighting is high as it relates to the core business model. Positioned at the top of the risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT breaches
risks.summary: A breach in security measures or cloud services could severely damage reputation and operations.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited with strong language (possibility of compromising data protection and IT security measures). Mentioned in key risks. Context exacerbated by SaaS offering. High-impact category.

risks.title: Software errors
risks.summary: Bugs or defects in software could disrupt services and lead to financial losses.
risks.score_rationale: Recurring mention of undetected errors or bugs. Concerned language (risk of defects, delays, or interruptions). High operational impact for critical customers.

risks.title: Intense competition
risks.summary: Competitive pressure may affect market share and the ability to innovate.
risks.score_rationale: Cited among key factors that could affect results. Standard language but set against a dynamic technology market. Less dramatic than operational risks.

risks.title: Dependence on a single business line
risks.summary: Lack of diversification exposes the company to fluctuations in its primary sector.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as a vulnerability (dependence on a single line of business). Full exposure to sector cycles. Major strategic risk highlighted in the text.

risks.title: Risks related to generative AI
risks.summary: The use of generative and agentic AI entails technological and operational risks that are not yet fully controlled.
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly mentioned with cautious language (risks associated with the use of generative and agentic AI). Reflects an emerging exposure. High weighting due to AI being central to MANH's innovation.

risks.title: Geopolitical instability
risks.summary: Geopolitical conflicts may disrupt international operations and supply chains.
risks.score_rationale: Cited with concrete examples (wars in Ukraine and the Middle East). Serious but generic language. Indirect impact via international operations and global business risks.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions regarding AI or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K report.
